_comment: Seed fixtures lifted verbatim from design/TrailShare.dc.html (ROUTES and TOURS arrays). Backend seeders and e2e fixtures should use these so the running app matches the design's screenshots. Coordinates are [lat, lng]. Users are derived from the author/guide names.

routes.name: Medvednica Ridge Loop
routes.author: Ivana Kovač
routes.description: A steady climb through beech forest onto the ridge, then an easy return along the old logging road.

routes.name: Sljeme Summit Climb
routes.author: Marko Babić
routes.description: The direct line to the summit. Relentless for the first hour, rewarded with the whole Zagreb basin below.

routes.name: Sava Riverside Cruise
routes.author: Ivana Kovač
routes.description: Flat, fast and shaded most of the way. A good first ride for anyone new to longer distances.

routes.name: Samobor Hills Traverse
routes.author: Petra Novak
routes.description: Rolling gravel between vineyards with three short punchy climbs and a bakery stop at the halfway point.

routes.name: Jarun Lake Circuit
routes.author: Ivana Kovač
routes.description: One lap of the lake on packed gravel. Pushchair-friendly, and never more than ten minutes from a bench.

routes.name: Zelenjak Gorge Trail
routes.author: Marko Babić
routes.description: Exposed scrambling above the Sutla river. Do not attempt in the wet — the limestone turns to glass.

tours.notes: Layered clothing and 1.5 L of water. We break for 20 minutes at the ridge shelter.
Fitness required — 880 m of gain with no easy bail-out. Poles strongly recommended.
Any bike in working order is fine. Helmets required, spare tubes provided.
Gravel tyres or a hardtail. Two cafés on route, bring cash for the bakery.
Autumn colours edition — slower pace, more photo stops.
